claims.text: A file stores data in secondary storage so that it is kept after the program ends and can be read again by the same or another program.

claims.text: A text file is opened with OPENFILE and a mode: READ to read lines from the start, WRITE to create the file afresh, APPEND to add lines to the end of an existing file.

claims.text: EOF(<file>) returns TRUE when there are no more lines to read, so a loop that reads a whole file tests NOT EOF(<file>) before each READFILE.
